translations.web: They zealously seek you in no good way. No, they desire to alienate you, that you may seek them.
translations.bsb: Those people are zealous for you, but not in a good way. Instead, they want to isolate you from us, so that you may be zealous for them.
translations.kjv: They zealously affect you, but not well; yea, they would exclude you, that ye might affect them.
translations.asv: They zealously seek you in no good way; nay, they desire to shut you out, that ye may seek them.
